testCases.title: Verify brand filter display on product overview page
steps: Navigate to the product overview page.
expectedResults: The brand filter is displayed on the product overview page.

testCases.title: Verify product grid updates with selected brand checkboxes
steps: Navigate to the product overview page.
Select one or more brand checkboxes.
expectedResults: The product grid updates to show only products from the selected brands.

testCases.title: Verify product grid updates with both category and brand filters
steps: Navigate to the product overview page.
Select one or more category checkboxes.
Select one or more brand checkboxes.
expectedResults: The product grid updates to show products matching both the selected categories and brands.
